name: POST /events cannot append a protocol-bearing kind
why: Fails with 201 if `validateRaise` is bypassable. `claim_raised` carries a whole Claim, so a generic append lets any client hand-build one — falsifier rule and all — and never reach a validator. The message must name the owning route, or a client that found the wrong door is left guessing.

error.message: claim_raised is not directly appendable — use POST /claims
